FIELDS.NAME: Scholarly Supplies Store
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Store Manager, phone: (555) 123-4567, email: john.smith@scholarlysupplies.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Scholarly Supplies Store, we specialize in the retail of educational materials, school supplies, stationery, and art supplies targeted at students, parents, and educators. Our operations focus on providing a wide selection of high-quality products, ensuring that all items intended for children meet applicable safety standards. We prioritize security with standard measures such as locked display cases and adequate lighting throughout our commercial premises. Our knowledgeable staff members are dedicated to assisting customers with their educational needs, while we regularly assess our inventory and offer seasonal promotions, particularly during back-to-school periods. We do not host in-store instructional activities or provide equipment rentals, helping to reduce liabilities and maintain a safe shopping environment. Additionally, our online sales are carefully managed to not exceed 25% of total annual revenue, further minimizing cyber risks.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2022, a theft incident occurred at the store due to a broken window, resulting in a loss of $2,500. The incident was reported to the local police, and a claim was submitted to our insurance provider. The status of the claim is currently pending review.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday: 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Steel security safe, Class B, UL listed, 500 lb capacity
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central Station Alarm System and Security Fencing
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Scholarly Supplies Store does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials as part of its operations. The focus is solely on retailing educational materials and school supplies without exposure to such risks.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Scholarly Supplies Store does not sponsor athletic teams as part of its operations. The focus is primarily on retailing educational materials and school supplies.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The store manager, John Smith, is responsible for checking the certificates.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – The applicant has not been indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – The Scholarly Supplies Store has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Scholarly Supplies Store does not lease employees to or from other employers. All staff members are employed directly by the store.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Scholarly Supplies Store carries Workers' Compensation insurance to ensure compliance with legal requirements and to provide coverage for our employees. This policy is actively maintained and protects against potential workplace injuries.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Scholarly Supplies Store does not own or operate any other business. Our focus is solely on providing educational materials and school supplies.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Scholarly Supplies Store does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. The only active policy is the current one mentioned.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Scholarly Supplies Store is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations are focused solely on the retail sale of educational materials and school supplies.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Scholarly Supplies Store does not rent or loan equipment to others, as this practice is not permitted to reduce liability and property damage risks associated with rental operations.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – The applicant has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. They maintain a stable financial standing and focus on their retail operations without such incidents.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Scholarly Supplies Store does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations are focused solely on the retail of educational materials and school supplies.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Scholarly Supplies Store does not have any known catastrophe exposure as our operations focus on retailing educational materials without engaging in high-risk activities. We maintain a secure and compliant environment for our customers and staff.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Scholarly Supplies Store has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The store maintains strict hiring practices and prioritizes a safe environment for both employees and customers.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Scholarly Supplies Store has no uncorrected fire code violations and is committed to maintaining a safe environment for customers and staff. Regular inspections ensure compliance with all relevant fire safety regulations.
